Job Descriptions :

1. Supervise and coordinate daily hatchery operations to meet production plans.

2. Monitor hatchery processes, water quality, and seed quality parameters.

3. Ensure strict adherence to SOPs, biosecurity, quality, and safety standards.

4. Support production planning, scheduling, and coordination with technical teams.

5. Lead and evaluate supervisors and operational staff.

6. Report operational issues and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications:

1. Diploma (D3/D4) or Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Fisheries, Aquaculture, Marine Science, or a related field.

2. Minimum 2 years of experience as a Larvae Production Supervisor or 3 years of experience as a Larvae Production Technician in a shrimp hatchery.

3. Strong knowledge of shrimp hatchery operations, including larval rearing, live feed production, water quality management, and biosecurity practices.

4. Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to oversee daily production activities and achieve production targets.

5. Good communication skills in English will be an advantage

6. Willing to travel and be placed across company units throughout Indonesia.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan :

1. Mengawasi dan mengoordinasikan operasional harian hatchery udang untuk memastikan target produksi tercapai.

2. Memantau proses hatchery, kualitas air, dan kualitas benur/larva guna menjaga performa produksi yang optimal.

3. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap SOP, protokol biosekuriti, standar mutu, dan keselamatan kerja.

4. Mendukung perencanaan produksi, penyusunan jadwal, serta koordinasi dengan tim operasional dan teknis terkait.

5. Memimpin, mengembangkan, dan mengevaluasi kinerja supervisor serta staf

6. Laporan isu operasional, sekaligus mendorong perbaikan berkelanjutan dan penyelesaian masalah operasional.

Kualifikasi

1. Diploma (D3/D4) atau Sarjana (S1) Perikanan, Akuakultur, Ilmu Kelautan, atau bidang terkait.

2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Supervisor Produksi Larva atau 3 tahun sebagai Teknisi Produksi Larva di hatchery udang.

3. Memahami operasional hatchery udang, termasuk pemeliharaan larva, produksi pakan alami, manajemen kualitas air, dan penerapan biosekuriti.

4. Memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan dan manajemen tim yang baik untuk mengelola aktivitas produksi harian serta mencapai target produksi.

5. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dalam Bahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah

6. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas dan ditempatkan di unit perusahaan di seluruh Indonesia.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
